sources.excerpt: Michael K. (Mike) Wirth, 66, has been Chairman of the Board and Chief Executive Officer of Chevron Corporation since 2018.

sources.title: Meet Mike Wirth, Chairman of the Board and CEO — Chevron
sources.excerpt: He joined Chevron as a design engineer in 1982 and holds a bachelor’s degree in chemical engineering from the University of Colorado.

sources.title: Meet Mike Wirth, Chairman of the Board and CEO — Chevron
sources.excerpt: Wirth serves on the board of directors of the American Petroleum Institute, Catalyst and the National Football Foundation, and is a member of the National Petroleum Council, the Business Roundtable, the World Economic Forum International Business Council, the American Heart Association CEO Roundtable, The Business Council, and the American Society of Corporate Executives.

sources.title: Chevron Corporation, Form 8-K, September 27, 2017 (Item 5.02)
sources.excerpt: Also on September 27, 2017, to be effective February 1, 2018, the Board elected Michael K. Wirth, currently Vice Chairman of the Board and Executive Vice President of Midstream and Development, to the positions of Chairman of the Board and Chief Executive Officer of Chevron.

sources.title: Chevron Corporation, Form 8-K, September 27, 2017 (Item 5.02)
sources.excerpt: Mr. Wirth, 56, has been Vice Chairman of Chevron since February 2017 and Executive Vice President of Midstream and Development since 2016, with responsibility for supply and trading, and Chevron’s midstream operating units engaged in transportation and power, as well as corporate strategy; business development; and policy, government and public affairs.

sources.title: Chevron Corporation, Form 8-K, September 27, 2017 (Item 5.02)
sources.excerpt: He served as Executive Vice President of Downstream and Chemicals from 2006 to 2015. From 2003 until 2006, Mr. Wirth was President of Global Supply and Trading, responsible for leading Chevron’s worldwide supply and trading operations as well as its aviation, marine and asphalt businesses.

sources.title: Chevron Names Michael K. Wirth Vice Chairman (Form 8-K Exhibit 99.1)
sources.excerpt: SAN RAMON, Calif., Jan. 25, 2017 – Chevron Corporation (NYSE: CVX) said today that Michael K. Wirth, executive vice president of Midstream and Development, has been named vice chairman, effective February 1, 2017.

sources.title: Chevron Names Michael K. Wirth Vice Chairman (Form 8-K Exhibit 99.1)
sources.excerpt: In assuming his new role, Wirth will join the company’s Board of Directors and add Policy, Government & Public Affairs to his existing portfolio of responsibilities.

sources.title: Chevron Names Michael K. Wirth Vice Chairman (Form 8-K Exhibit 99.1)
sources.excerpt: Wirth, 56, joined Chevron in 1982 as a design engineer. Since that time, he advanced through a number of engineering, construction and operations positions.

sources.title: Chevron Names Michael K. Wirth Vice Chairman (Form 8-K Exhibit 99.1)
sources.excerpt: Earlier, Wirth was president of Marketing for Chevron’s Asia/Middle East/Africa marketing business, based in Singapore. He also served on the board of directors for Caltex Australia Ltd. and GS Caltex in South Korea.

sources.title: Meet Michael Wirth, the man who could soon lead Chevron (CNBC)
sources.excerpt: Having served in engineering, construction, and operations positions since joining Chevron in 1982, Wirth became president of marketing for Chevron's Asia, Middle East and Africa business in 2001.

sources.title: Meet Michael Wirth, the man who could soon lead Chevron (CNBC)
sources.excerpt: Wirth, 56, spent much of his time at Chevron in its refining and chemicals segment.

sources.title: News from the CU system - CU-Boulder (Distinguished Engineering Alumni Award 2010)
sources.excerpt: Michael Wirth, who earned his bachelor's degree in chemical engineering at CU-Boulder in 1982, is receiving the award in the industry and commerce category.

sources.title: News from the CU system - CU-Boulder (Distinguished Engineering Alumni Award 2010)
sources.excerpt: Originally from Golden, Wirth now directs Chevron's refining, marketing, and trading businesses as executive vice president for global downstream at the company's headquarters in San Ramon., Calif.
